categories.main_business_segments: West China Cement Limited primarily engages in the production and sale of cement and related products, including aggregates and commercial concrete. The Group also operates a financial leasing business through its subsidiary Guangxin International. Its operations span both domestic markets in China and overseas markets in Africa and Central Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs New Suspension Preheater (NSP) technology across all production facilities, with many plants located near limestone quarries to minimize transportation emissions. It uses conveyor belt systems for raw material transport, heat-recycling plants to reduce electricity consumption by about 30%, and denitration (De-NOx) equipment to reduce nitrous oxide emissions by approximately 60%. The Group also incorporates dry-process pre-decomposition production technology in new plants, especially overseas.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include railway construction companies, real estate developers, and concrete manufacturers. The Group serves infrastructure projects such as highways, railways, bridges, hydroelectric power stations, water conservancy, and urban and rural construction markets in Western China, Uzbekistan, Mozambique, D.R. Congo, Ethiopia, and other African countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Shaanxi, Xinjiang, and Guizhou provinces in China, with significant overseas presence in Uzbekistan, Mozambique, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Rwanda, Angola, and Uganda. It has production capacities distributed across these regions and targets both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: West China Cement operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on cement production and sales. It also extends upstream into mining operations for raw materials and downstream into aggregates and commercial concrete production, as well as financial leasing services related to its core business.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group emphasizes energy conservation, emission reduction, and environmental protection, investing in cutting-edge environmental technologies and smart factory initiatives. It focuses on expanding overseas markets, optimizing domestic market layout, enhancing production efficiency, and developing talent and innovation capabilities. The Group also pursues green mine projects and sustainable safety development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of cement and related products, provision of construction and installation services, sales of plastics bags, trading of cement-related raw materials, and sales of gypsum. The financial leasing business also contributes interest income from loan receivables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group holds a leading market position in Shaanxi Province, especially in eastern and southern regions, benefiting from high barriers to entry due to transportation costs. It competes in both domestic and international markets, leveraging strategic locations and government policies. Major competitors are other cement producers in China and emerging players in African markets, but the Group maintains competitive advantages through scale, technology, and environmental compliance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB8.34 billion, a 7.5% decrease from 2023, with cement sales volume of 20 million tons. Gross profit declined by 19.8%, but profit attributable to owners increased by 48.6% to RMB626.2 million. Total assets grew by 10.3% to RMB36.29 billion, with a net gearing ratio of 65.3%. The Group continues to invest in capacity expansion, especially overseas, with capital expenditures of RMB4.6 billion in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group differentiates itself through its strategic geographic positioning, advanced NSP technology, strong environmental and emission control standards, and integration of upstream and downstream operations. It offers high-quality cement products tailored for infrastructure and urban development projects, supported by stable supply, cost control, and government policy alignment. Its overseas expansion and adoption of innovative technologies further enhance its competitive edge.
